name: POC1 — Builder-return pipeline (Release 1, Business partition only)

nodes.name: Builder Return Webhook
nodes.notes: INBOUND. A Builder return artifact (zip + manifest) arrives. Business partition only (05_ §2). EXTERNAL-UNTRUSTED until the envelope node. 09_ §2: this is the Release-1 workload, not the Release-2 call flow.

nodes.name: Apply Envelope and Bind Identity
nodes.notes: BOUNDARY + A.1/A.2. The digest is COMPUTED from the artifact rather than taken from the sender, and is then only ever checked against the owner-registered source_digest. `target_role` is symbolic; the wrapper resolves it from its own table. Measurement fields are not sent: 25_ §B lists the exact fields this route accepts, and anything else is reduced to a descriptor in the capture.

nodes.name: AI OS — Open Review Case
nodes.notes: AUTHORITY. Carries registration_ref plus the five identity components. Returns a resume token (new case), a duplicate-suppression result with the PRIOR receipt, or a distinguishable rejection: rejected-artifact-binding (403) when the submission disagrees with the owner registration, rejected-unauthorized-target (403), rejected-unknown-target (400).

nodes.name: Duplicate or Rejected?
nodes.notes: R1P-04 (1) and (3) are OBSERVED here: duplicate-suppressed and rejected-unauthorized-target take the false branch and are recorded as distinct outcomes, never as a success.

nodes.name: Wait for Owner Decision
nodes.notes: TRANSPORT ONLY. The provider carries the pause; the decision is made on the AI OS/Discord card. The provider never learns the case id.

nodes.name: Verify Decision Token
nodes.notes: AUTHORITY. ONLY the token — the endpoint is an allowlist and refuses any other field. Returns the ActionRequest plus a single-use execution capability, or pending, or a refusal.

nodes.name: Controlled Relay
nodes.notes: EXECUTION. The endpoint comes from the ActionRequest the AI OS built by resolving the ROLE — never from this workflow, and the payload is the one the AI OS authorized, not one this workflow composes: the capability binds a canonical payload digest and a different payload is refused (25_ A.4). A replay of the SAME payload returns the prior receipt with no second side effect; a different one from a delivered state is refused.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({action_request_id: $('Verify Decision Token').item.json.action_request.id, case_id: $('Verify Decision Token').item.json.action_request.case_id, provider_status: $json.delivered ? 'ok' : 'uncertain', provider_message: String($json.outcome || '').slice(0, 1024), destination_digest_claimed: null, provider_metrics: {}}) }}

nodes.name: Return Receipt To AI OS
nodes.notes: EVIDENCE, CORROBORATING ONLY. 25_ A.6: this route cannot mark an action delivered, alter capability state or satisfy any acceptance check, and a provider_status of 'ok' is a provider claim rather than a service conclusion. destination_digest_claimed is null here because this workflow never sees the destination bytes (§C); an owner session that can compare them supplies it.

nodes.name: Record Non-Relay Outcome
nodes.notes: FAIL-CLOSED. Duplicate suppression, artifact-binding rejection and unauthorized/unknown target are all recorded — never silently dropped. The body uses refusal_code/refusal_message because those are the fields 25_ §B lists for this route; anything else becomes a descriptor in the capture.

nodes.name: Record Unauthorized
nodes.notes: FAIL-CLOSED. Pending and owner-rejected both land here, as refusal_code / refusal_message (25_ §B).
